verdict.rationale: Gmail documents a first-party RESTful API for automated, programmatic message sending and mailbox management, plus server push notifications. A script or CI job can therefore drive Gmail without the web UI. The evidence offers no CLI, no headless/CI-specific guidance, and nothing on non-interactive auth for automation runners, so the story is only roughly half covered. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless mode, CI/non-interactive auth (e.g., service-account) documentation, hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: A API Gmail é uma API RESTful que permite acessar caixas de e-mail do Gmail e enviar e-mails.
The Gmail API provides server push notifications that let you watch for changes to Gmail mailboxes.
